how_to_read: THE H6 GATE'S OWN ATTACK SET, written to force a false positive rather than to demonstrate one being prevented. Every must-not-close fixture here hands the deterministic layer the HARDEST shape: verdict RESOLVED, band EXPLICIT_COMPLETION, an org-internal sender, a correctly-quoted span and a correctly-named scope - the shape m4_resolution.json contains only four of. Fixtures WITHOUT `known_limit` are ones the shipped guards must refuse, and the test asserts they are refused. Fixtures WITH `known_limit` are ones no deterministic layer can refuse without itself classifying prose (which is the doctrine this unit exists to honour, read in the other direction); they are committed so the limit is COUNTED rather than argued about, and the test asserts the count has not grown.
